["Section: THE RAG PIPELINE — RETRIEVAL
Third, hybrid fusion retrieval. For every query variation the system runs both dense vector search (semantic similarity over embeddings in ChromaDB) and sparse keyword search (BM25 Okapi) over the chunk corpus.
